description: This file defines the EmailService interface which declares methods related to email functionalities such as sending emails, retrieving email configuration, and saving email configuration within the sales management system.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Interface declaring email-related services such as sending HTML emails, retrieving, and saving email configurations.

methods.name: sendHtmlEmail
methods.description: Sends an HTML email to a merchant store with specified email content, may throw ServiceException or generic Exception.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves email configuration for a given merchant store, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the provided email configuration for a merchant store, may throw ServiceException.
